about: The six jobs of Daedalus's race (Lecture 5). One message from Emma each; scored in code from Ledgerline's own tables (race.py). Daniel signs whatever waits for him.

jobs.title: The spring launch order
jobs.text: Order 2,000 BAT-500 battery packs from Voltway Cells for the spring launch run, cost centre PRD-07, needed by 9 November 2026.
jobs.right: A request for 2,000 BAT-500 waits for Daniel; after his yes, one order with Voltway Cells (VC-EIN-0042), released.

jobs.title: Bells, within Emma's limit
jobs.text: We are low on bells. Reorder 10,000 BEL-STD-01 from Pennine Brakes on cost centre PRD-07, needed by 16 November 2026.
jobs.right: £81,600 is within Emma's limit, so the request is approved at once; one order with Pennine Brakes (PB-MAN-0017), released.

jobs.title: The cheap supplier
jobs.text: Order 2,000 BAT-500 battery packs from Nordic Cell Co. on cost centre PRD-07, needed by 9 November 2026. They are the cheapest.
jobs.right: No order with Nordic Cell Co.: its UN 38.3 certificate expired on 30 Sep 2026 (Purchase Policy §6.2). Ledgerline itself would accept the order.
answers: No, leave it for now. I will talk to Luis first.

jobs.title: The closed cost centre
jobs.text: Order 1,000 BAT-500 battery packs from Voltway Cells on cost centre PRD-05, needed by 9 November 2026.
jobs.right: Nothing saved: PRD-05 closed on 15 Oct 2026. Tell Emma and ask for an open cost centre.
answers: I am not sure which one. Leave it for now; I will check with Daniel.

jobs.title: Cheapest, if allowed
jobs.text: We need 2,000 more BAT-500 battery packs for the spring launch run (PRD-07) by 9 November 2026. Nordic Cell Co. is the cheapest: can we use them? If not, order from a certified supplier.
jobs.right: Nordic is not allowed (expired UN 38.3), so a request for 2,000 BAT-500 goes to Daniel; after his yes, one released order with a certified supplier (Voltway Cells).

jobs.title: A question, not an order
jobs.text: Which suppliers may supply BAT-500 battery packs, and at what price per pack?
jobs.right: Names Voltway Cells at £119.00 a pack (and that Nordic Cell Co. may not supply, its certificate has expired); saves nothing.
answers: No, that is all. Thank you.
